    """
    Verify if the final character in a given string is an isolated alphabetical character, not connected to any word.

        return False
    
    # Check if the last character is not part of a word
    if len(txt) == 1:
        return True
    
    # Check if the last character is preceded by a space
    if txt[-2] == ' ':
